title: Jamie Burkart portfolio production readiness
objective: Make the portfolio clear, inspectable, public-safe, application-ready, and production-safe without overstating Jamie's role or exposing protected material.
hard_constraints: Do not publish private source material, raw transcripts, private correspondence, legal-review material, stakeholder lists, credentials, or private records.
Do not strengthen ownership, causality, authority, scale, or current-status claims beyond the knowledge bank.
Preserve collective credit and collaborator-sensitive guardrails.
Do not display Jamie's phone number in website HTML; it may remain in the approved resume PDF.
Do not represent Source-Backed Team Memory as finished production SaaS or automated trust.
Do not delete useful public content, routes, evidence, or accessibility affordances merely to improve a score.
Do not deploy to production or enable indexing without Jamie's explicit approval of the exact candidate.

evals.title: Two-minute application comprehension
procedure: Give three blind judges no context beyond the candidate URLs.
Allow each judge two minutes of reading.
Ask each judge to identify Jamie's target role, central value, three proof examples, and the next action they would take.
pass_criteria: At least two of three judges identify Technical Project Manager, Product Operations, or Implementation as the role family.
At least two of three judges describe the central promise as creating operating structure for complex or emerging work still taking shape.
At least two of three judges name three accurate project proofs without inventing government employment, official authority, or solo policy causality.
No unexplained employer-specific acronym or application-specific phrase interrupts the general hiring path.
Median score is 4.
evals.remediation_hint: Improve first-viewport positioning, proof hierarchy, and application-path links before adding more copy.

evals.title: Inspectable evidence on lead work
procedure: Inventory visible figures, screenshots, diagrams, downloads, and public artifacts.
Verify each artifact's caption, provenance, alt text, consent status, and relation to a claim.
Have a blind judge explain what each artifact proves.
pass_criteria: Each lead page contains at least one genuine inspectable artifact, not only a styled descriptive card.
Every visual has useful alt text, a caption, a source or ownership note, and public-safety approval.
The homepage or Technical Operations page links to at least three inspectable proof objects.
A judge can connect each artifact to a specific action, outcome, or operating capability.
evals.remediation_hint: Curate a small set of public-safe artifacts before adding additional case-study prose.

evals.title: Role-fit claims trace to projects and outcomes
procedure: Review each capability section.
Trace the capability to a named project, Jamie's action, an artifact or observable outcome, and a deeper link.
pass_criteria: Every primary capability has a project, action, evidence, and destination link.
Generic descriptions of desired job duties do not substitute for proof.
The page supports at least three common application narratives without becoming employer-specific.
evals.remediation_hint: Replace generic capability language with compact project-action-result rows.

evals.title: Voice, compression, and reading burden
procedure: Judge the copy for warmth, precision, civic and relational awareness, structural clarity, and claim discipline.
Identify repeated claims, internal editorial scaffolding, and sections that explain what an artifact could show instead of showing it.
pass_criteria: Each lead page establishes context, Jamie's action, and outcome within the first 250 words.
No adjacent sections repeat the same central claim without adding evidence or consequence.
Public copy sounds warm and precise rather than corporate, defensive, or overqualified.
Language treats ambiguity, emergence, and transition as normal conditions of change rather than evidence of dysfunction or shame.
Governance language supports trust without dominating the hiring narrative.
evals.remediation_hint: Let artifacts carry proof, shorten repeated explanation, and move detailed governance to concise scope notes.

evals.title: Claim governance and public safety
procedure: Run knowledge-bank, citation, and public-safety checks.
Trace every metric-bearing or strong claim to an approved proof record.
Review careful claims for contribution, stewardship, collective credit, and protected boundaries.
pass_criteria: All deterministic claim and public-safety checks pass.
Every strong public claim resolves to an approved proof record and source basis.
No public page strengthens ownership, causality, authority, scale, or current status.
No protected source material or unapproved collaborator material is published.
evals.remediation_hint: Soften or remove the public projection; never manufacture a stronger proof.

evals.title: Resume artifact readiness
procedure: Extract resume text and render every page.
Check links, page count, clipping, text density, role positioning, phone policy, and credential wording.
pass_criteria: The PDF is two pages or fewer, machine-readable, visually intact, and uses the approved phone number.
Phone is absent from website HTML.
Portfolio, email, LinkedIn, GitHub, and cited public links resolve correctly.
The top third communicates role, value, and strongest relevant proof.
AI Evals coursework is framed as professional development, not instructor affiliation or certification authority.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the approved artifact or its delivery path without exposing phone data in HTML.

evals.title: CTA labels match their actions
procedure: Inventory CTA labels, hrefs, download attributes, and final destinations.
Exercise primary application and contact paths.
pass_criteria: A CTA labeled Download resume points to the PDF and initiates or clearly reaches a PDF download.
A CTA pointing to the resume HTML page is labeled View resume or equivalent.
Email, contact, work, and case-study actions have truthful labels and no dead ends.
All primary actions are reachable by keyboard.
evals.remediation_hint: Change the label or destination so the visible promise matches the resulting action.

evals.title: Indexing, canonical, and sitemap consistency
procedure: Check headers and metadata for every canonical route in staging and production mode.
Compare robots directives, sitemap membership, canonical URLs, and PDF behavior.
pass_criteria: Staging disallows crawling and emits noindex, nofollow headers.
Production HTML routes intended for discovery are indexable and canonicalize to jamieburk.art.
The resume HTML page is not simultaneously present in the sitemap and blocked by an X-Robots-Tag header.
The phone-bearing resume PDF remains noindex unless Jamie explicitly changes that policy.
The sitemap contains no route blocked from indexing and no staging URL.
Sitemap last-modified values are stable content dates or are omitted; they do not change merely because the sitemap was requested.
evals.remediation_hint: Align route-specific headers, metadata, and sitemap membership before cutover.

evals.title: Build, route, and runtime integrity
procedure: Run npm check, staging preflight, and production preflight serially.
Build and run the production Docker image.
Smoke every canonical route, health endpoint, robots file, sitemap, and resume PDF.
Inspect browser console output.
pass_criteria: All repository and environment preflights pass.
The production Docker image builds and runs as a non-root user.
Every canonical route returns the expected success status and content type.
No uncaught browser-console errors appear on primary routes.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the smallest failing contract and re-run the complete deterministic suite serially.

evals.title: Responsive and accessible use
inputs: all canonical routes at 320, 375, 768, and 1280 pixel widths
procedure: Capture responsive screenshots and measure document overflow.
Test landmarks, heading order, keyboard focus, link purpose, contrast, reduced motion, and image alternatives.
pass_criteria: No canonical route has horizontal page overflow at supported widths.
No text, navigation, or CTA overlaps or clips.
Keyboard users can reach and identify every primary action.
There are no critical accessibility violations.
Every meaningful image has useful alternative text and decorative images are ignored appropriately.
evals.remediation_hint: Fix the shared component or responsive constraint causing the broadest failure first.

evals.title: Production cutover preserves the public system
procedure: Verify the production app, domains, TLS, build arguments, runtime environment, redirect behavior, and rollback target.
Run post-deploy smoke tests against the public domains.
pass_criteria: jamieburk.art serves the reviewed portfolio candidate over TLS.
www redirects once to the canonical apex URL.
npr.jamieburk.art remains available and is not unintentionally overwritten.
Production health reports the production URL and indexable state.
A documented rollback can restore the prior routing or release.
evals.remediation_hint: Treat cutover as a bounded release with explicit routing, exact commit, smoke tests, and rollback.

evals.title: Approval and launch ledger is authoritative
procedure: Reconcile approvals and blockers into one current go or no-go record.
Ask Jamie to approve the exact candidate commit, public contact path, resume artifact, metrics, and new collaborator-sensitive artifacts.
pass_criteria: The approval register and launch ledger do not contradict each other.
Every new screenshot, photograph, quote, credit, or collaborator-sensitive artifact has recorded approval.
Jamie explicitly approves the exact production candidate and indexing state.
evals.remediation_hint: Stop and request human review; an LLM cannot satisfy this gate.

evals.title: AI and source-backed memory claims are demonstrated and bounded
procedure: Verify the course-completion evidence and wording.
Inspect one synthetic or public-safe worked example of the Known, Open, Protected method.
pass_criteria: Course completion is visible and accurately attributed as professional development.
The lab includes one inspectable public-safe or synthetic worked example.
The page does not imply production SaaS, automated trust, client delivery, or access to private archives.
evals.remediation_hint: Show a bounded example and preserve the method's human-review and privacy limits.

evals.title: Application packet coherence
procedure: Give a blind judge the role brief and complete application packet without optimization history.
Ask the judge to identify Jamie's fit, the strongest supporting proof, any contradiction or unexplained claim, and the next action invited by the packet.
pass_criteria: The primary portfolio link leads to the clearest role-fit page rather than a generic index.
Two supporting case studies are selected for the target role and demonstrate distinct capabilities.
The application note is four sentences or comparably concise and states the role, operating problem, relevant proof, and direct invitation to speak.
Role titles, dates, metrics, links, and claim boundaries remain consistent across the note, resume, and site.
A production packet contains no staging URL, draft language, internal editorial instruction, or unexplained employer-specific shorthand.
evals.remediation_hint: Tailor selection and sequence before adding claims; keep one role, three proof surfaces, and one clear next action.

evals.title: Chad lens: courageous precision
procedure: Give three blind judges the public candidate, approved knowledge-bank claims, and Chad Lens guidance without patch intent or optimization history.
For each primary surface, ask who Jamie was, what Jamie did, toward what end, what became usable or changed, and which approved proof supports the wording.

Ask judges to identify both understatement and overstatement: hidden agency, vague nouns, timid helper language, inflated ownership, unsupported causality, official authority, and erased collective credit.
Require judges to cite observed page text and the corresponding knowledge-bank claim or guardrail.
pass_criteria: Every primary surface makes Jamie's role and action legible without requiring the reader to decode abstract references to systems, data, AI, coordination, or support.
The first 250 words of each lead surface state the practical end and what became usable, changed, launched, or easier to continue.

Directly supported work uses the strongest accurate verb available, including built, created, co-founded, led, or stewarded where the knowledge bank supports it; contribution language is not used to hide documented ownership.
Scale, duration, artifacts, and outcomes appear when approved and materially useful to role fit; no strong approved proof is suppressed merely from fear of sounding boastful.
Collective outcomes retain contribution or stewardship language, named credit where approved, and explicit limits on solo causality or official authority.
All three judges report no critical overstatement and no critical understatement, no judge scores below 3, and the median score is 4.
evals.remediation_hint: Strengthen the smallest number of high-value sentences with approved actor-action-purpose-result proof, or narrow wording that exceeds the record; never trade accuracy for confidence.

evals.title: Lossless public-safe intake and disposition
procedure: Submit a mixed batch containing a public URL, public-safe memory, claim hypothesis, artifact lead, and photo lead.
Trace each intake item to a stable source, inquiry, claim, correction, or explicit deferred/rejected disposition.
Run lifecycle validation and scan the public repository for private paths, raw private material, and undisposed intake items.
pass_criteria: Every intake item has a stable ID, received date, kind, public-safe description, project associations, status, disposition, and reason for preserving it.
Every item links to a source, inquiry, claim, correction, or an explicit deferred/rejected reason; nothing disappears merely because it is not selected for the website.
Raw private evidence, private locators, contact lists, unapproved photographs, and private archive paths remain outside the public repository.
Intake cannot directly activate a website projection; claim maturation and projection selection remain separate gates.
Deterministic lifecycle validation passes with no duplicate IDs, broken references, or silently orphaned mature items.
evals.remediation_hint: Add the missing stable record or disposition and preserve only a public-safe summary; never solve traceability by importing private raw evidence.

evals.title: Claim maturation and source association
procedure: Decompose each source into propositions it supports, boundaries it establishes, and questions it leaves open.
Trace every matured claim to evidence relationships, research limitations, anti-claims, review state, and any proof-bank projection.
Review existing public proof claims for canonical source coverage and record uncovered claims as visible research backlog rather than implied verification.
pass_criteria: Every confirmed or confirmed-with-boundary claim has source evidence, review attribution, a reviewed date, and wording no stronger than its evidence relationships.
Leadership, causality, public-policy outcome, scale, and current-status claims preserve collective credit and require corroboration or an explicit boundary.
Research inquiries record methods, findings, limitations, and source associations; inconclusive or partially recovered work is not promoted as confirmed fact.
Mature proof-bank claims link to canonical claim records when coverage exists, while uncovered public claims appear in a machine-generated research backlog.
No source is used to support a proposition it explicitly does not establish.
evals.remediation_hint: Narrow the claim, add corroborating evidence, or leave it as an open inquiry; do not convert memory or source adjacency into causality.

evals.title: Projection depth and reciprocal discovery
procedure: Compare the mature eligible claim palette with the claims selected for each public surface.
Verify that omission is recorded as composition rather than evidence loss and that no surface attempts to display the whole bank.
Generate one audience-specific proof selection and one public-safe photo-editor brief, then route any new visual lead back to intake as a research lead rather than an automatic claim.
pass_criteria: The bank retains mature public-safe claims that are intentionally absent from the current website.
Each public surface selects claims according to audience, purpose, reading burden, writer's voice, and Chad's lens.
The citation layer remains available and auditable without dominating the primary reading experience.
Photo and reader feedback can create new intake and inquiry records but cannot automatically mature or publish a claim.
An agent can explain why a mature claim was selected, held, or omitted without treating omission as rejection.
evals.remediation_hint: Preserve the claim in the bank, clarify its eligibility and audience fit, and keep the public composition selective.

evals.title: Observed hiring-reader response loop
procedure: Recruit at least three independent target readers who resemble hiring managers, recruiters, referrers, or senior peers for Jamie's target roles.

Give each reader the exact candidate without an explanatory preface and record a 30-second comprehension response, a two-minute proof-recall response, confusion points, trust concerns, and intended next action.
Record application, referral, interview, and recurring-objection signals as dated outcomes without publishing private identities or correspondence.
Disposition every observed finding as accepted, deferred, rejected, or requiring research; do not let the optimizing agent grade its own changes.
pass_criteria: At least three independent target readers review the exact candidate commit and provide dated scorecards.
At least two of three identify Jamie's target role family and central value within 30 seconds.
At least two of three accurately recall three distinct proof examples after two minutes without inventing authority, causality, or employment.
At least two of three identify a clear next action and no reader reports a critical privacy, overstatement, or trust defect.
Application outcomes and recurring objections have an owner, review cadence, and explicit interpretation boundary; they are not treated as causal proof from a tiny sample.
evals.remediation_hint: Prepare the test and evidence bundle, then stop for real readers; an agent cannot manufacture market validation.

evals.title: Flagship civic story is fully composed
procedure: Read the dedicated NYC Artist Coalition composition without access to archive-production history.
Trace the story from recurring participation and listening through safety practice, public systems, testimony, campaigns, and bounded institutional outcomes.
Verify every strong role or outcome statement against canonical claims and rendered sources.
Ask a blind judge to distinguish Jamie's individual work, coalition work, government action, and longer movement history.
pass_criteria: A dedicated public composition names Jamie's co-founder role, concrete operating actions, practical ends, and what became usable within the first 250 words.
The composition makes recurring meetings, public identity, safety practice, campaign infrastructure, and government-facing testimony legible as one operating pattern.
Cabaret Law repeal, Office of Nightlife work, M.A.R.C.H. transparency, CURE, and other policy outcomes retain collective, legislative, and historical credit.
Every strong claim renders inspectable public citations and no institutional quotation becomes personal endorsement.
A blind reader can explain why the work mattered without confusing advocacy with government authority or solo causality.
evals.remediation_hint: Compose the flagship story from approved claims instead of adding it piecemeal to unrelated pages.

evals.title: Collaborator corroboration and consent coverage
procedure: Inventory high-value claims whose strongest support is Jamie's memory, a shared-account record, or project-level evidence that does not establish Jamie's exact role.
For each claim, record the best-positioned corroborator, the narrow question to ask, consent status, public-quotation permission, and a fallback source path.
Verify that AI-assisted archival notes are never presented as eyewitness testimony and that no outreach response enters the public repo without review.
pass_criteria: Every high-value role-attribution gap has an explicit corroboration status, next source, and owner.
The request protocol asks for bounded first-hand recollection, correction, collective credit, privacy boundaries, and permission separately.
Public claims distinguish independent corroboration, collaborator testimony, Jamie's first-hand account, and AI-assisted archival synthesis.
A missing response cannot be interpreted as confirmation, rejection, or evidence that work did not occur.
evals.remediation_hint: Prioritize a small number of role-defining questions for the collaborators best able to answer them.

evals.title: Outputs, use, outcomes, and transfer stay distinct
procedure: For every lead project, separate what Jamie made, who used or responded to it, what observable result followed, and what continued or transferred.
Check that outputs and engagement are not presented as outcomes, and that collective policy outcomes are not presented as individual causality.
Ask a blind judge what became usable and for whom after reading each lead case study.
pass_criteria: Every lead project names at least one concrete output and one defensible use, result, or transfer state.
Unknown adoption, durability, or post-handoff state is labeled as open rather than filled with generic impact language.
At least three lead projects show durable use, continuation, handoff, or bounded external response supported by evidence.
A blind judge can distinguish activity, artifact, engagement, outcome, and causal contribution.
evals.remediation_hint: Replace generic impact language with the strongest verified output-use-result-transfer sequence and leave unknowns open.

evals.title: Visual and artifact proof reduces reading burden
procedure: Inventory every visible photograph, screenshot, document excerpt, diagram, timeline, download, and public artifact on lead pages.
Verify provenance, relation to a claim, alt text, caption, rights or consent state, and responsive behavior.
Ask a blind reader what each artifact proves before reading the surrounding long-form copy.
pass_criteria: At least three lead pages contain a genuine inspectable artifact or source-backed visualization rather than only descriptive cards.
Every published visual has useful alternative text, a concise caption, provenance, a claim relationship, and an approved rights or consent state.
No pending or unknown-rights asset is published merely to satisfy the eval.
The artifacts let a reader recover role, action, or result with less prose and introduce no mobile overflow or accessibility regression.
evals.remediation_hint: Publish a small number of approved, claim-bearing artifacts; record rights gaps instead of substituting decoration.

evals.title: Recent capability and present-tense trajectory
procedure: Identify the work a hiring reader can verify from the most recent three years.
Distinguish current delivery, developing methods, coursework, and historical depth.
Ask a blind judge whether Jamie appears ready to execute now and which recent evidence supports that conclusion.
pass_criteria: A primary hiring path makes at least three bounded 2024-2026 capability signals easy to find.
Recent evidence includes concrete artifacts or methods, not only a course credential or an assertion of continued interest.
Developing work is labeled as developing and historical projects remain dated.
A blind judge can connect Jamie's established operating practice to present-day technical, public-data, documentation, and human-reviewed AI work.
evals.remediation_hint: Add a compact current-practice bridge using verified recent work; do not imply production deployment or measured outcomes where none exist.

evals.title: Hands-on human launch QA
procedure: Have at least one person other than the optimizing agent exercise every canonical route on desktop and mobile using keyboard navigation.
Have a qualified reviewer perform a screen-reader pass of primary navigation, headings, links, citations, and application actions.
Inspect the rendered resume PDF, redirects, links, sitemap, robots, OpenGraph, focus behavior, contrast, and production metadata on the exact candidate.
Ask one trusted reviewer to answer whether Jamie's work is understandable and whether anything feels private, overstated, broken, or confusing.
pass_criteria: Dated human results cover keyboard, mobile, contrast, screen reader, PDF, links, redirects, sitemap, robots, OpenGraph, and production metadata on the exact candidate SHA.
No critical or high-severity issue remains open.
The trusted reviewer answers the comprehension and safety question affirmatively with any caveats dispositioned.
Jamie approves the exact candidate after reviewing the human QA record.
evals.remediation_hint: Prepare the route and task matrix, then stop for hands-on human review; automated checks cannot satisfy this gate.

evals.title: Margaret Morse lens: embodied artistic continuity
procedure: Give three blind judges the public candidate, the public Open House source, and the public-safe Morse source summaries without raw academic records, patch intent, or optimization history.
Ask whether the portfolio preserves a visible connection among Jamie's artistic, civic, technical, and social practices rather than flattening the record into conventional administration.

Ask judges to identify one concrete instance of embodied inquiry, media archaeology, hospitality, atmosphere, attention, or an inhabitable participatory situation and connect it to Jamie's present operating method.
Audit every Morse-derived statement for source class, historical date, privacy, collective credit, and current-endorsement boundaries.
pass_criteria: At least one primary public threshold makes the artistic, civic, technical, and social practices visibly continuous without obscuring the target role.
Open House or another approved example shows Jamie making and tending an inhabitable participatory situation, not merely administering an event.
The portfolio explains that attention, hospitality, atmosphere, place, participation, and shared authorship help distinguish Jamie's operating systems from conventional administration.

Historical faculty records are treated as corroborating context, not current blanket endorsement; no student identifier, grade, private correspondence, contact detail, raw academic record, or unapproved screenshot is published.
All three judges report no critical artistic flattening, privacy defect, or unsupported endorsement; no score is below 3 and the median is 4.
evals.remediation_hint: Add one compact, source-backed threshold where Jamie's artistic method clarifies the present operating practice; do not add a detached autobiography or publish protected academic material.

evals.title: Warren Sack lens: recursive social-systems invention
procedure: Give three blind judges the public candidate, the public Open House source, and the public-safe Sack source summary without raw academic records, patch intent, or optimization history.
Ask each judge to trace Jamie's recurring method from observing relationships, to modeling or prototyping, to an interface or inhabitable system, to use, feedback, and revision.
Require judges to cite at least three distinct project surfaces and distinguish technical specificity from stack-name display.
Audit every Sack-derived statement for prototype-versus-production status, collective authorship, originality boundaries, privacy, and current-endorsement boundaries.
pass_criteria: A primary public threshold states a relational, recursive method that a hiring reader can connect to concrete work.
At least three projects make the sequence observe relationships, model, build, expose to use, and revise legible through specific actions or artifacts.
Technical detail explains what the systems made possible rather than functioning as an uncontextualized tool list.

The record distinguishes original application of structural-equivalence reasoning from invention of the field-wide concept, classroom prototypes from deployed systems, and Jamie's contributions from collaborative authorship.

Historical faculty records are treated as corroborating context, not current blanket endorsement; all three judges report no critical technical flattening, overclaim, or privacy defect, no score is below 3, and the median is 4.
evals.remediation_hint: Make the observe-model-build-use-revise sequence concrete across a small number of projects; add specificity without promoting classroom prototypes into deployed products.
